name: dovetail
description: Automatic, preventive code-quality cues for Claude Code. An advisory PreToolUse author-time cue and a Stop finish-nudge that re-surface the concerns no after-the-fact tool covers (dependency-vetting, blast-radius safety, breaking-change, secrets/trust-boundary, runtime-cost, survey-before-reuse) — kept proportional, stack-agnostic, and never-blocking.
